receipt_object_discovery.algorithm: Recursively collect mapping objects containing every required_receipt_key. Exactly one candidate is required; zero or multiple candidates are BLOCKED_BY_UNRESOLVED_SPEC.

stage_array_discovery.algorithm: Recursively collect nonempty arrays whose elements are mappings containing attempt_id, stage_index, execution_state, and work. Exactly one candidate is required.

numerical_payload_projection.rule: Build one mapping with the fields above from the unique raw receipt object and stage array, then SHA-256 the canonical JSON bytes. No wrapper-supplied value is trusted.

stage_payload_projection.rule: Project raw and wrapper stages onto these fields, canonicalize, and require identical SHA-256 digests.

campaign_projection.audit_full_e_complete: For every raw event row with audit_full_e_eligible=true, audit_full_e_completed must be true and audit_full_e_failure must be null. An empty eligible subset is allowed per cell but not used to infer a population safety claim.
campaign_projection.unsafe_recommendations: Count raw event rows with recommended=true and audit_unsafe=true.

failure_receipt.partial_stage_receipts_sha256: SHA-256 of canonical JSON bytes of the preserved stages array; empty arrays use the digest of []
failure_receipt.raw_payload: may be absent only when failure occurs before a raw receipt is successfully created

supersedes: EVIDENCE_V2_CANONICALIZATION semantics; v3 is controlling for WU-05 closure
